incidents.accused_name: Two males on black Pulsar motorcycle
incidents.raw_fir_text: On 15-07-2026 at around 22:30 hours, complainant Mr. Vikram Sethi was walking outside Toit Pub on 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar. Two unidentified men riding a black Bajaj Pulsar motorcycle without a registration number plate approached him from behind. The pillion rider snatched a gold chain weighing 24 grams valued at approx Rs. 1,60,000 and an iPhone 15 Pro from complainant's hand, causing minor injury to his neck. Accused fled towards Domlur flyover. CCTV cameras at 12th Main junction captured motorcycle fleeing at high speed.

Complainant Ms. Meera Natarajan reported that while exiting MG Road Metro Station at 14:15 hrs, an individual carrying a sharp iron blade threatened her and demanded cash and jewelry. The assailant forcibly took Rs 15,000 cash from her purse and threatened bodily harm if she shouted. Eye-witness auto drivers identified suspect as Ramesh alias Chotta, a habitual offender previously booked at Commercial Street PS.

incidents.accused_name: Unknown caller posing as Digital Arrest Officer
incidents.investigating_officer: Cyber Crime Cell - Inspector K. Rao
incidents.raw_fir_text: Complainant received a WhatsApp video call from an individual wearing police uniform claiming to be from TRAI and Mumbai Cyber Police. The caller falsely alleged that a SIM card registered in complainant's Aadhaar was linked to money laundering. Under panic and threat of immediate arrest, complainant transferred Rs 4,50,000 across 3 transaction IDs to beneficiary account in HDFC Bank. Bank freeze request initiated.

Night burglary at Apartment 402, Tower B, Prestige Shantiniketan. The occupants were away in Mangaluru. Main door lock broken using crowbar between 02:00 and 03:00 hrs. Gold ornaments weighing 150g, silver utensils, and Rs 80,000 cash stolen from master bedroom safe locker. Fingerprint forensics team and dog squad dispatched to scene. 3 masked individuals recorded on perimeter CCTV scaling rear boundary wall at 02:14 hrs.

Altercation broke out near Ashoka Road vegetable market over shop parking space. Accused Manjunath along with two associates assaulted complainant Siddaraju with wooden clubs causing head injuries and fracture to left arm. Victim rushed to KR Hospital Mysuru. Accused apprehended on spot by patrolling police team. Weapon wooden club recovered.

Complainant was waiting at HSR Sector 1 bus stop when a grey TVS Jupiter scooter pulled alongside. Rider wearing black helmet snatched handbag containing laptop, wallet, and bank cards. Scooter sped towards Silk Board Flyover.

incidents.location_name: Electronics City Phase 1 IT Park Road
incidents.raw_fir_text: Commercial break-in at IT Hardware distribution warehouse in Phase 1. Window grilles tampered with. Server components and copper wiring worth Rs 3,20,000 stolen overnight. Forensic analysis in progress.

Based on credible intelligence, police team raided near Shirur Park railway underpass. Two suspects caught red-handed carrying 4.5 kg of commercial quality Cannabis (Ganja) concealed in travel bags. Vehicles seized.

incidents.accused_name: Fake Port Authority Logistics Scam Operator
incidents.raw_fir_text: Complainant duped of Rs 1,85,000 under pretext of customs clearance fee for container shipment at Mangaluru Port. Suspect created fraudulent domain mimicking port clearance portal.
Attempted robbery in basement parking of Jayanagar 4th Block complex. Suspect threatened woman with kitchen knife demanding car keys. Complainant pressed panic alarm, scaring off suspect into crowd.
